description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Earth 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Guy], [Silent Support Damage Tracker] and [Silent Support Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Guy
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Silent Support (0~2), removed after using Silent Support two times

description.name: Silent Support Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Silent Support level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Guy]

description.name: Silent Support Level
description.text: Keeps track of Silent Support level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Guy]
